title: bpcells_regress_out
description: Regress out the effects of confounding variables using a linear least squares regression model with BPCells.

Dataset input.title: Dataset input
Dataset input.description: Dataset input using nf-tower "dataset" or "data explorer". Allows for the input of multiple         parameter sets to initialise a Nextflow channel.

param_list.description: Dataset input can either be a list of maps, a csv file, a json file, a yaml file, or simply a yaml                 blob. The names of the input fields (e.g. csv columns, json keys) need to be an exact match with the workflow input parameters.

modality.description: The modality to run this component on.

input_layer.description:
The layer of the adata object to regress on.
If not provided, the X attribute of the adata object will be used.

var_input.description: Boolean column in .var used to select which genes to regress out (e.g

output_layer.description:
The new layer of the adata object in which the regressed data is stored.
Pass an empty value (or null from Nextflow) to not store the regressed data, e.g

output_layer_compression.description:
GZIP compression level to use for the regressed output layer.
By default no compression is applied.

obsm_pca_output.description:
If provided, the regressed data is scaled and a PCA is computed with BPCells,
without loading the regressed data into memory

varm_pca_output.description: In which .varm slot to store the PCA loadings

uns_pca_output.description: In which .uns slot to store the PCA variance and variance ratio.

num_components.description: Number of principal components to compute.

scale_max_value.description: Clip the scaled data to the interval [-scale_max_value, scale_max_value] before running the PCA

overwrite.description: Allow overwriting the .obsm, .varm and .uns PCA slots.

nextflow input-output arguments.title: Nextflow input-output arguments
nextflow input-output arguments.description: Input/output parameters for Nextflow itself. Please note that both publishDir and publish_dir are supported but at least one has to be configured.
